title: Seiko Presage Zen Garden SSA468J $695 Delivered @ Watch Depot
body:
Deal: Seiko Presage Zen Garden SSA468J $695 Delivered @ Watch Depot

[dav3] Perfect for those just starting out in the "waste management" business
[Gunnar] Calling that watch 'Zen' about is the most blatant case of fraudulent advertising since The Never-Ending Story.
[kolorijo] The cherry blossom 🌸 colorways is quite nice.
[G-Shock] Agree about being an acquired taste but is a bit of a trifecta of yuk for me - gold.. Roman numerals, and open heart (grow up) 😂.
No doubt it looks better in real life, like most promo photos, however there are plenty more nicer standard presages for less. Not very good deals these days but got the Irish coffee for $389 for example.
41.8mm is pretty big too for a more or less stress watching. 38.5-39.5mm presages are the best imo. Legibility is pretty average too on 2/3 of those.
As you were.
[boozed] Don't forget the vestigial 24 hour dial that Japanese watchmakers seem to be obsessed with
[Benno123] I have an old zen garden presage with a white dial and blue hands which i quite like, but this is… eww. I can't explain why but I also really don't open heart watches. It looks like pretty much all the zen garden watches you can buy now are open heart which is a bit of a shame
[donga100] The pink face version is $50 cheaper and less garish in my opinion.
